manifest.title: Tripod stepping generator (FlySuite-fitted)
manifest.claim: Without it, a walking command produces no coordinated stepping: the animal falls or freezes.

manifest.title: Steering-command adaptation leak
manifest.claim: Without it, the steering DNs' standing left/right imbalance becomes a permanent turn.

manifest.title: Head-grooming front-leg sweep (7 Hz antiphase)
manifest.claim: Without it, grooming DNs fire but the front legs never sweep the head.

manifest.title: GF/loom escape detection + TTM jump program
manifest.claim: Without it, giant-fibre bursts and looming takeoff DNs fire but the fly never jumps.

manifest.title: Righting reflex (inverted -> wing push + leg flail)
manifest.claim: Without it, an upside-down fly never rights itself.

manifest.title: Footfall reafference gain
manifest.claim: Without it, every step reports its own footfall as external touch.

manifest.title: Escape gating near walls, pivots and grooming
manifest.claim: Without it, looming by self-motion (walls, pivots, grooming sweeps) triggers escape jumps.

manifest.title: GF->TTMn electrical synapse
manifest.claim: Without it, giant-fibre spikes cannot trigger the TTM jump.

manifest.title: LC10 small-object drive from a nearby fly
manifest.claim: Without it, another fly in view drives no LC10 neurons, so visual courtship initiation is lost.

manifest.title: Locomotor bout scheduler (walk/stop/groom + saccades + takeoff draw)
manifest.claim: Without it, the fly never starts a spontaneous walking or grooming bout and never saccades.

manifest.title: Feeding stop on food + local search afterwards
manifest.claim: Without it, a hungry fly tasting sugar walks straight over the patch and never loops back.

manifest.title: Contact/heat avoidance (back-off, graze turn, heat escape)
manifest.claim: Without it, head-on contact, wall grazes and noxious heat drive no avoidance behaviour.

manifest.title: Male courtship pursuit and song trigger
manifest.claim: Without it, the pheromone/LC10 pathway still drives courtship DNs but the male never chases or sings.

manifest.title: Female rejection: decamp run and hind-leg kick
manifest.claim: Without it, a courted female behaves exactly as if no male were present.

manifest.title: Flight saccades and ahead-clearance avoidance
manifest.claim: Without it, a flying fly makes no spontaneous turns and no collision-avoidance saccades.

manifest.title: Arousal signal for locomotion (OA level, hunger fallback)
manifest.claim: Without it, starvation and octopamine have no effect on walking bouts, drive or takeoff rate.

manifest.title: Hunger hormones (AKH/IPC) -> octopamine -> threshold and sensory modulation
manifest.claim: Without it (brainOpts.neuromod=false), or with the OA channel blocked (neuromod.block), starvation does not change firing thresholds or locomotion.

manifest.title: Courtship song generator (pulse trains / sine)
manifest.claim: Without the courtship plugin it is never driven; the wing-song motor pattern itself lives here.

manifest.title: Wing flight controller
manifest.claim: The connectome supplies no flight command (scripts/wing_mn.mjs, roadmap M1); this controller executes takeoff, thrust, steering and landing.
